reference.limits: Not published on the pages opened. Public RSS 2.0 feed (rssfeed.asp, ttl 5, iso-8859-1) of the latest offers with title, dc:creator (company), link, description. No developer / API programme (/api, /developers return the SPA home); robots.txt Disallow: / for unlisted agents and blocks AhrefsBot, MJ12bot, PetalBot, Yandex … No terms page with automation wording located.

reason: The only machine-readable interface is the RSS 2.0 feed https://www.net-empregos.com/rssfeed.asp (re-checked 2026-09-25: 'Content-Type: application/xml; Charset=iso-8859-1', ~250 items, no search parameters; the server also resets connections from non-browser User-Agents). Remaining gap: charset-aware decoding of non-UTF-8 XML responses — the TypeScript runtime decodes every body as UTF-8 (accents become U+FFFD) and the Python runtime re-encodes the decoded text as UTF-8 before parsing it under the document's iso-8859-1 declaration (accents become mojibake); the 2026-09-25 additions (CSV, JSON parts, token placement, assertions) do not touch response decoding.
